build_dqn_agent: build a JAX-based DQN agent with custom network, optimizer, and replay buffer hyperparameters
create_default_dqn_agent: create a default DQN agent with an MLP network and Adam optimizer using default_agent
run_select_action: run epsilon-greedy action selection on a dm_env timestep using the DQN agent
test_dqn_update: test the DQN agent update method that adds transitions to replay and performs SGD steps
review_training_state: review the TrainingState namedtuple holding params, target_params, optimizer state, and step count
